text:
Kuch baatein thi jo dil ke hi kisi kone mein reh gayi,
Tumne pucha nahi, aur humse kabhi kahi nahi gayi.
Faasle chahe jitne bhi ho darmiyaan hamare,
Tumhari khamoshi mein aaj bhi meri hi aahat beh gayi.
title: Adhoori Si Baat
description: A soft and heartfelt social status about unexpressed love and silent feelings.
